title: Wraps - The Email Platform for Amazon SES
excerpt: Deploy everything Amazon SES needs into your own AWS account with one command: event tracking, bounce handling, templates, workflows, and a dashboard. You pay AWS directly.
content_html:
Email for teams on AWS.

One command deploys Amazon SES into your AWS account. Then send, broadcast and automate from the Wraps dashboard, or let your agent do it through the platform.

Read the docs

credentials storedcredentials we store

What Wraps does

Send, broadcast, automate, and keep it healthy.

  1. 01

    Send with one call.

    A typed TypeScript SDK that talks straight to SES. Every send, delivery, open and click lands in a table you own.

  2. 02

    Send a broadcast.

    Write it once, choose who gets it, and send now or schedule it. Every recipient can unsubscribe in one click, and you see the whole funnel afterwards.

    Contacts · Segments · Topics · Double opt-in · Scheduling

  3. 03

    Automate the rest.

    Workflows send for you when something happens: a signup, an event, a topic change, a schedule. Wait, check what the contact did, then send the next email or text.

    Triggers · Delays · Conditions · Email · SMS

  4. 04

    Keep your sending healthy.

    Wraps watches your bounce and complaint rates and your domain's authentication, and alerts your team early so you can fix the cause. One command shows what is behind a climbing rate.

AWS costs are separate

You pay AWS directly for sending at $0.10 per 1,000 emails on à la carte — AWS now defaults new accounts to $0.16, and Wraps tells you which plan applies — plus infrastructure (~$2-5/mo). The infrastructure lives in your account, so you can leave anytime and keep everything.

Calculate Your Costs

Get started

Start free. Nothing already in your account is touched, and the infrastructure is yours if you ever leave.
